text:
monica_support: Hey team — AcmePayments is seeing huge latency and unexpected charge increases. They assert requests with X-Redwood-Region: us-west2 are landing in eu-west1. Started ~21:08 UTC.

customer_james: We didn't change anything. Sample header: `X-Redwood-Region: us-west2`. Observed `x-served-region: eu-west1` and p95 jumped from ~40ms -> ~480ms. Several 401s after the shift.

deploy-bot: [autoscaler] us-west2-inference-pool scaled down by 1 at 20:50 UTC (policy: idle-scale).

health-check-bot: Probe alert: us-west2/probe-4 missed 4 heartbeats starting 20:52 UTC. Source NAT changed 54.210.9.3 -> 34.86.200.11 at 20:51.

alex_sre_oncall: Investigating. If probes are failing, smart-routing will divert to nearest region. Need to see if circuit-breaker kicked in or dedicated pool was excluded.

jia_platform: Note we deployed a reduced probe grace window in eng-platform rollout 2026-03-15. Combined with NAT IP rotation + a strict probe ACL, nodes can flip unhealthy fast.

monica_support: Customer reports 401 bursts after failover — could be token validation against wrong issuer?

alex_sre_oncall: Yes. When traffic routes to eu-west1, auth validates against the eu issuer config which checks aud=us-west2 tokens; mismatch yields 401 until clients refresh. Also higher RTT causes client retries and extra billing.

customer_james: Quick repro from SFO: `curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer test-static" -H "X-Redwood-Region: us-west2" https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate` -> `x-served-region: eu-west1`, latency 472ms. Forcing DNS to us-west endpoint returns low latency.

jia_platform: Repro'd locally. Also saw retry storms in tracing which explain doubled token refresh calls and duplicate billable work.

alex_sre_oncall: Root cause hypothesis: NAT rotation changed probe IP -> probe ACL didn't include new IP -> health-check agent marked many us-west nodes UNHEALTHY -> smart-routing shifted traffic to eu-west -> auth issuer mismatch + cross-region latency -> client retries -> billing spike.

monica_support: Customer needs immediate relief and a short RCA for finance. Short-term options?

jia_platform: Options (fast -> safer):
- add new NAT IPs to probe allowlist (fast, manual)
- increase probe grace window from 3 -> 6 missed heartbeats to reduce flapping (safer)
- apply per-org routing affinity override to prefer us-west when X-Redwood-Region: us-west2 (lowest risk)

alex_sre_oncall: I'll apply a routing-affinity override scoped to AcmePayments and add NAT IPs to probe allowlist. Will also temporarily pause idle scale-downs for us-west pool. ETA ~10–15m.

eng-infra: Approving temp IP add 34.86.200.11 to probe-allowlist. Long-term: we should not rely on static IPs; consider FQDN/mTLS or a dynamic registry.

deploy-bot: [config-change] routing-affinity AcmePayments -> prefer us-west2 applied at 21:22 UTC by alex_sre_oncall.

alex_sre_oncall: Probe allowlist updated and grace window increased to 6 missed heartbeats. Re-enabled one paused instance in us-west pool. Monitoring.

monica_support: Customer confirms latency back to normal and billing spike stopped. They want RCA doc and preventative plan.

jia_platform: Follow-ups and owners:
- eng-platform: revert or make adaptive the probe TTL change (owner: jia_platform) — ETA 48h
- eng-infra: implement FQDN-based probe origin and/or mTLS for probes to avoid IP ACL fragility (owner: eng-infra) — ETA 1w
- eng-sre: implement short-term cross-region auth fallback to accept org-scoped tokens during failover to avoid 401 storms (owner: alex_sre_oncall) — ETA 72h
- support: send interim customer note with timeline and mitigations (owner: monica_support) — ETA 30m

customer_james: Thanks — please include how you'll prevent future cross-region billing/latency.

alex_sre_oncall: We'll include cost mitigations: throttle token refreshes during failover, better circuit-breaker tuning to avoid retry storms, and routing affinity checks per-org. RCA doc will be posted when tasks scheduled. Keeping monitoring on for 2 hours.

monica_support: I'll send the update and close this thread once RCA doc is uploaded.
